en.title: Fabricated Integrity
en.premise: On a rainy day I find myself drawn to a peculiar second‑hand bookstore that opens only when the sky is wet, in search of a diary I thought I had left behind—a record of memories I had penned. Guided by the shopkeeper’s cryptic instructions, I purchase fragments of the diary, only to discover a chilling account of a murder I had long forgotten. Declaring myself the “witness” to the case, I chase the truth, but the diary’s prose soon stirs an unbearable déjà vu and unsettling dissonance that threatens to unravel everything.

zh.title: 伪造的诚实
zh.premise: 在雨天，我被一间只在雨天才开门的古书店吸引，去寻找曾经交给店主的那本记忆记录日记。店主的神秘引导让我逐步购买回日记的碎片，却发现其中记录着一桩我已遗忘的惨烈谋杀。自称为“案件的目击者”，我追寻真相，却在日记的笔触中感受到难以忍受的既视感与不安，仿佛一切都在悄悄崩塌。
